resources.string:
Unfret looks at a shop page, an ad or a service provider's page and tells you in plain words whether it all adds up.

• Share a link to Unfret from any app, or paste it here. The page opens inside Unfret, on your phone, over your own connection, so you can accept a cookie banner or solve a captcha.

• Nothing is read until you tap Check this page. Then Unfret reads the page on your phone: the product facts and the visible text. Account menus, greetings, forms, checkout and delivery areas, and any address that isn't the business's own are removed first. On a private seller's ad, the seller's name is never read.

• Only those facts, that text and the page address are sent, to unfret.net, with your Unfret pass. Nothing about you or your phone.

• Each check uses one check from your pass. Checks are bought on unfret.net, not in this app.

• The app keeps only your pass on the phone, encrypted. Pages you open aren't kept: their cookies and cache are deleted when you close them.
Paste a product or ad link
Or share a link to Unfret from your browser or a marketplace app.
Set up your pass below, then check this link.
Paste your Unfret pass to start. You get one when you buy checks on unfret.net.
Unfret has a new free start: your old pass has ended.
A new pass comes with free deep checks. Get one on unfret.net: check a link there, then copy the pass from My checks and paste it here.
Checks are bought on unfret.net. Come back here when you have your pass.
It starts with ufk_. It is stored on this phone only, encrypted.
That isn\'t an Unfret pass (it starts with ufk_). Copy it again in full.
Unfret doesn\'t know this pass (or it was replaced with its backup code).
Remove the pass from this phone?
Its checks stay on the pass. Keep a copy of it (or its backup code) to use it again.
Use the dev server (dev.unfret.net, test network)
This is a beta, an early version: things may still change. Tell us what doesn\'t work at hello@unfret.net.

Sending this shares this one check\'s product facts, page text and result with Unfret for review. Personal details are removed first; once reviewed, it is kept without any link to you. If the score was far off, you get free checks.

Unfret reports risk signals from what the page shows; it never calls a shop a scam. The page may change after this check.
